contact.title: Get in Touch
contact.subtitle: Have a question, want to partner with us, or just want to say hello?
contact.sent_desc: Thank you for reaching out. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.
contact.form_message_placeholder: Tell us how we can help...
contact.for_businesses_desc: Own an escape room? Partner with UNLOCKED and reach thousands of new customers.
contact.faq1_q: How do I book an escape room?
contact.faq1_a: Simply browse our rooms, pick your date and time, select the number of players, and complete the booking. You'll receive your booking confirmation instantly.
contact.faq2_a: Yes! You can cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours before your booking. Go to "My Tickets" in the app or website to manage your bookings.
contact.faq3_a: Every time you escape a room, your stats are updated. You earn points based on difficulty, time, and hints used. Climb the leaderboard and collect badges!
contact.faq4_q: I own an escape room business. How do I list my rooms?
contact.faq4_a: Register as a business partner through our portal. After accepting terms and selecting a plan, our team will review and approve your listing within 48 hours.
contact.faq5_a: We support credit/debit cards and various payment options. Some venues also accept pay-on-arrival or a 20% deposit to secure your booking.
contact.faq6_q: Is the app available on iOS and Android?
contact.faq6_a: Yes! UNLOCKED is available on both the App Store and Google Play. Simply search for "UNLOCKED" and download the app.
